2. Match image2's slender elderly body and head/body proportions. Existing generated heads are slightly oversized; reduce heads about20percent uniformly in all sixframes, keeping same face, glasses and brownhair. Body and limb lengths stay consistent and unchanged. The head/body ratio is the same across allposes, and everyframe belongs to the same character at identical sprite scale.
